integrity: Original proof and standalone standard-library finite checker included. No independent audit or outside certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only independent uniform random mappings on finite labeled sets; no conditioned-model extension.
The second-order threshold has o(sqrt(n)) remainder, not a bounded error.
Exact mixed moments might be implicit in older mapping frequency-spectrum machinery; novelty assessment is qualified.
Finite checks and numeric examples do not validate the infinite asymptotics.
title: A second-order component-size covariance crossover in uniform random mappings
